annotations.title: State tax, NIIT and AMT estimate

description: Estimate a household's 2026 federal income tax, net investment income tax (3.8%), alternative minimum tax and resident state income tax in one pass. States: CA, NY, PA, IL, OH, GA, NC, MI, TX, FL, NV, SD, WY, AK, TN, NH, WA (the ten most populous plus states without a wage income tax; Washington's capital gains tax included). Each state's figures carry the year they come from; every result says which rules were applied. Standard deductions only; local income taxes and most credits are not modeled.

ages.description: Ages of the filers at year-end (for senior deductions and state retirement exclusions).

isoSpread.description: Bargain element of ISOs exercised and held at year-end (AMT preference).

netInvestmentIncome.description: Net investment income for NIIT (default qualifiedIncome).

otherIncome.description: Interest, Roth conversions and other ordinary income.

qualifiedIncome.description: Qualified dividends plus net long-term capital gains.

state.description: Two-letter state of residence (omit for federal only).

taxableSocialSecurity.description: Taxable part of Social Security benefits.

wages.description: Wages, including RSU vests and NSO exercises.
